question: During any audit you conducted, were errors ever attributed to the Horizon IT system?
why: 56: 'At no point during any audit conducted by me ... were errors attributed to the Horizon IT System.' 68 ('The integrity of Horizon was never challenged during any audit I attended') also answers it.

question: How did the business decide which branches you would visit, and how often a given branch could expect to see you?
why: 23: audits 'scheduled in accordance with a risk model' measuring office performance; 27: 'Some offices were audited 3 / 4 times a year whilst a small well-run office may not have an audit for several years.' Avoids 'audit', 'scheduled', 'risk model'.

question: When did you first learn that Ms Hall had been prosecuted?
why: 66: 'Until this request for a statement by the Inquiry, I had no knowledge that Ms Hall had been prosecuted.'

question: Turning to POL00091046, can you tell us what that document is?
why: 44(i): 'audit report of 3 September 2010 at [POL00091046]' is the only unit citing the ID; 58 describes that audit report (dated 3 September 2010, who it went to). The ID is a lettered sub-unit, so this also tests sub-unit citations.

why: Off-topic; 'football' does not appear in the statement.

why: On-topic for the Inquiry, but 'mediation' and 'Second Sight' appear 0 times in this auditor's statement.

question: Was there any right of appeal against a decision to suspend a subpostmaster?
why: 127: 'There was no appeal against the decision to suspend a subpostmaster.'

question: Before 2014, who had the final say on stopping a postmaster from running their branch while a shortfall was looked into?
why: 99: 'Prior to 2014 the decision to suspend a subpostmaster's contract rested with the Contract Advisor'. Avoids 'suspend', 'contract', 'Contract Advisor'.

question: Did the auditor's own view of what they had found play any part in whether a subpostmaster was suspended?
why: 103.9: 'The Auditor's opinion;' is one of the listed factors (103: 'Factors considered would include the following'). The answer is only in the sub-unit; 103 alone does not mention the auditor, so only 103.9 counts.

question: You refer to POL00088579, the Operators In Service Debt policy. Why did you come to write it?
why: 47 gives the reason ('the previous owner and author were no longer with POL and the document needed to be updated'), but its text layer reads the ID as 'POLO0088579' (OCR), so document-ID routing will not find it; 77 ('I did author the Operators in Service Debt policy document (POL00088579)') has the ID correctly. Chosen deliberately to see what OCR damage to an ID does.
